Professional Summary
Focused backend and full-stack developer with strong experience designing and delivering scalable Node.js services and APIs. Proven track record improving performance and reliability of transaction and data platforms through database optimization, caching, and cloud deployments. Effective at cross-functional collaboration, documentation, and driving feature delivery in Agile environments.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS, Redis, Postgres, Jira, Git, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior Node.js Developer, Saffron Bank (May 2025 - Present)
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs with Express.js for retail banking microservices, enabling a new payments onboarding flow that processed 150k transactions/month; improved median API response time by 40% through route-level optimizations and query tuning using MongoDB.
- Implemented schema design and indexing strategies in MongoDB to reduce query latency for account lookups; introduced connection pooling and monitoring which decreased connection errors by 60%.
- Led code reviews, CI pipelines and incident postmortems using Git and Confluence; partnered with product and QA to ship secure endpoints with automated tests tracked in Jira.

Full Stack Developer, Wipro (Jan 2022 - Apr 2025)
- Built Node.js backend services and APIs for an enterprise compliance platform, integrating with Postgres for relational data and MongoDB for document storage to support mixed workloads; improved data sync throughput by 3x through batching and optimized queries.
- Developed TypeScript services and Express.js routes, and added Redis caching to reduce repeated lookups, cutting average page load times by 55% for dashboard users.
- Coordinated deployments on AWS and maintained deployment runbooks in Confluence; managed feature delivery and sprint work in Jira while using Git-based branching for release stability.

Backend Engineer, Zoho (May 2017 - Dec 2021)
- Architected and maintained backend services in Node.js/Express.js supporting multi-tenant SaaS features, using MongoDB as primary document store and Postgres for relational components; implemented data migration tools and rolling upgrades to avoid downtime.
- Leveraged AWS services for compute and storage, designed auto-scaling groups and monitoring to handle traffic spikes; integrated Redis for session caching, reducing DB read load by 45%.
- Drove performance tuning efforts, added observability and logging, and authored system design documents in Confluence; tracked development and incidents through Jira and managed code via Git.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
